Title: Nationwide randomised trial evaluating elective neck dissection for early stage oral cancer (SEND study) with metaanalysis and concurrent real-world cohort
Author: Hutchison et al.
Comment: SE_diff stores the derived standard error of log(HR), calculated from the explicitly reported 95% CI as [ln(1.04) − ln(0.48)]/(2×1.96) = 0.19724. Arm-specific DFS event counts were not reported, so event fields are null. The non-randomised observational cohort and paper-level meta-analysis were excluded from this study-level RCT synthesis.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Elective neck dissection (END) with local resection') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Design Type: Multicentre randomised controlled trial; intention-to-treat analysis
Study Environment: 25 hospitals in the UK National Cancer Research Network
Topic of Content: Elective versus delayed therapeutic neck dissection in clinically node-negative early oral cancer
Participant type: Patients aged at least 16 years with histopathologically confirmed T1/T2 oral squamous cell carcinoma and clinically/imaging node-negative neck
Recruitment source: 25 hospitals across the UK National Cancer Research Network
Outcome measurement: Disease-free survival from surgery or excision biopsy to local, regional or distant recurrence, new primary tumour, or death from any cause; analysed using Cox regression
effect_direction: HR < 1 favours elective neck dissection (longer disease-free survival)

Title: Elective versus Therapeutic Neck Dissection in Node-Negative Oral Cancer
Author: D’Cruz et al.
Comment: M_diff stores log(HR)=ln(0.45), and SE_diff was derived from the reported 95% CI as [ln(0.59)-ln(0.34)]/(2×1.96)=0.140606357 for meta-analysis. The paper reports P<0.001; p_value is entered as the stated boundary 0.001, not as an exact equality. The Results call 81 and 146 'recurrences'; these were not entered as complete composite DFS event counts because DFS also included death from any cause. Final analyzed arm totals (243 and 253) come from Figure 2/Table 1, whereas the report describes an interim cohort of the first 500 randomized patients.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Elective-surgery group') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
domain: Early-stage clinically node-negative oral-cavity squamous-cell carcinoma
Study Environment: Single-center clinical trial at Tata Memorial Centre
Participant type: Adults aged 18–75 years with lateralized stage T1 or T2 oral-cavity squamous-cell carcinoma and a clinically node-negative neck
Outcome measurement: Interval from randomization to first documented relapse at any site (local, regional, metastatic, or second primary) or death from any cause, whichever came first
effect_direction: HR < 1 favours elective neck dissection (longer disease-free survival)
